title: PIMP Activation
concept_summary: Built as upbeat heartland rock / light country rock, it stays with a workday joker keeping strain tucked behind the grin. The pressure comes from holding a light public face over pressure he will not show. It leaves the release in the smile put back on while the pressure stays underneath.

lyrics:
[Intro]
vending machine light buzzing
he laughs a second too long

[Verse 1]
clocking in
got a line for everybody waitin'
he keeps the whole place easy

[Pre-Chorus]
break room laughter
he laughs a second too long
then puts the same good face back on

[Chorus]
he laughs a second too long
then clocks back in

[Bridge]
ain't askin' anybody to see it
just pull the grin back up again

[Outro]
break room laughter
he laughs a second too long
